name: Built-in sample: NotPrincipal resource policy - analyzer fails closed (scary-but-neutralized)
note: IAM-505 UI sample. Matches samples.js id 'neutralized-unsupported-notprincipal'. A dangerous-looking resource policy using NotPrincipal. The analyzer models identity-policy semantics only, so it fails closed BEFORE rule evaluation and returns a blocking coverage state (UNSUPPORTED_NOTPRINCIPAL) with the exact JSON path, rather than presenting confident findings on a shape it does not understand. Demonstrates the coverage/fail-closed neutralization path. Reuses fixtures/family/notprincipal-rejected.json intent.
